info.title: Humanize daemon
info.description: The methods an hmz daemon serves over a session of protocol/wire.md. Parameters are by name; a parameter a method does not list is refused. protocol/daemon.md states what each method does. Server-to-client notifications are listed under x-notifications.

methods.name: session.hello
methods.summary: Open the session: say the client's protocol and name.

methods.name: session.cancel
methods.summary: Ask the daemon to give up a call (a notification; never answered).

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: This document.

methods.name: pair.create
methods.summary: Make a pairing code.

methods.name: pair.claim
methods.summary: Pair this session's device with a token of a pairing code.

methods.name: devices.list
methods.summary: The paired devices.

methods.name: devices.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a paired device and close its sessions.

methods.name: hosts.list
methods.summary: Every host taken on.

methods.name: hosts.running
methods.summary: Every host whose epic or chat is going or stopping.

methods.name: hosts.open
methods.summary: Start the host of a workspace and slot, without attaching.

methods.name: hosts.status
methods.summary: One host's status.

methods.name: hosts.detach
methods.summary: Let every frontend of a host go.

methods.name: hosts.stop
methods.summary: Close a host.

methods.name: epic.attach
methods.summary: Attach to a host as one frontend; opens an epic subscription.

methods.name: epic.start
methods.summary: Start an epic on the host.

methods.name: epic.say
methods.summary: Say a line.

methods.name: epic.answer
methods.summary: Answer a question, in words or as a value of its schema.
methods.description: Takes question and exactly one of text and value. An answer that does not fit the question's schema is refused with DoesNotFit, its data holding errors, one {path, message} per error; the question stays waiting.

methods.name: epic.face
methods.summary: Read a face the flow made known, by its hash.

methods.name: epic.stop
methods.summary: Stop the epic going.

methods.name: epic.force

methods.name: epic.afk

methods.name: epic.claim

methods.name: epic.release
methods.summary: Release a role.

methods.name: epic.board
methods.summary: Write or remove a line of the board.

methods.name: epic.aside

methods.name: epic.unaside
methods.summary: Close a side conversation.

methods.name: epic.status
methods.summary: The host's status.

methods.name: epic.detach
methods.summary: Let this frontend go.

methods.name: epic.quit
methods.summary: Close the host.

Workspace.description: An absolute path of the daemon's machine, ~ expanded there.

Slot.description: "" for the workspace's own host, chat:<hex>, ai:<hex> or exec:<hex>.

Listener.description: A listener spec of Section 3.9.2 of [DAEMON].

EnvId.description: An environment of the host, as the envs snapshot names it (Section 4.24.2 of [DAEMON]).

EnvPath.description: A path relative to the environment's workdir, or an absolute POSIX path.

TermId.description: A terminal of the host (Section 4.24.4 of [DAEMON]).

Env.description: One environment of the envs snapshot (Section 4.24.2 of [DAEMON]).

EnvEntry.description: One path of an environment (Section 4.24.3 of [DAEMON]).

InvalidRequest.message: Not a JSON-RPC 2.0 request, a batch, or a call before session.hello.

InvalidParams.message: Parameters not as this document states.

NotPaired.message: This device is not paired: claim a pairing code first.

NotFound.message: What the call names does not exist.

Conflict.message: Refused in the state things are in, a host's refusal included.

TooLarge.message: More than a call or an answer here may carry.

Upstream.message: A program or service the daemon asked did not answer.

Unavailable.message: What the call needs cannot be reached now.

x-notifications.name: epic.event
x-notifications.summary: One message of an epic subscription (Section 4.9 of [DAEMON]).

x-notifications.name: notices.event
x-notifications.summary: One notice of a notices subscription, or its end where it fell behind.
